role: Baby villager play: on a 1-in-400 draw a child villager either chases another playing child for 1000 ticks or wanders to random spots; sets the isPlaying flag both sides use.

members.name: villagerObj
members.note: folded: the task runs on the villager itself (struct living); is_playing lives on it

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: AIC_PLAY case: growingAge < 0, rand(400), the nearest non-playing child in the 6x3x6 box, and a findRandomTarget(16,3) fallback draw that keeps the RNG order

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: setPlaying(true) when there is a partner, playTime = 1000

members.name: updateTask
members.note: --playTime; chase the partner beyond 2 blocks, otherwise re-wander when the path is empty
